svg.text: How a project score is built from the Panoptic principles, and where that score lands on the Sustainable Development Goals
P001 · Elsies River CHC and BFI Sub
Where the score lands: each sub-principle’s points are shared across its linked targets
(primary ×2, secondary ×1) and summed per goal. In the dashboard the SDG arcs rise in proportion.
